# Snowfeet Store

> > World's #1 manufacturer of short skis, skiskates, skiblades, and snowblades - innovative mini ski equipment designed in Czech Republic by founders Zbynek and Michael.

Snowfeet specializes in portable, beginner-friendly short ski equipment including their signature 38/44/50 CM skiskates, 65/99/120 CM skiblades, and WALKSKI backcountry touring skis. The company offers comprehensive tutorials, maintenance guides, and accessories like liquid wax for their products.

## Key Topics

- Skiskates
- Skiblades
- Snowblades

- Snowfeet 99 CM Skiblades
- WALKSKI Backcountry Touring
- Portable Winter Sports Equipment
- Beginner-Friendly Skiing
- Skiskating Technique
- Winter Sports Innovation
- Czech Republic Design
